name: WF-405 — Lead Qualification & AI Priority Scoring Controller

parameters.jsCode: const b=$json.body??$json; const leadId=String(b.leadId??'').trim(); const source=String(b.source??'').trim(); const channel=String(b.channel??'').trim().toLowerCase(); const campaignId=String(b.campaignId??'').trim(); return [{json:{...b,leadId,source,channel,campaignId,receivedAt:new Date().toISOString()}}];

const input=$('Normalize Lead Qualification Input').first().json; const ctx=$json.context??$json; const lead=ctx.lead??input.lead??{}; const property=ctx.property??input.property??{}; const seller=ctx.seller??input.seller??{}; const suppressed=Boolean(ctx.suppressed||lead.suppressed||seller.suppressed||input.suppressed); const dnc=Boolean(ctx.dnc||lead.dnc||seller.dnc||input.dnc); const invalid=Boolean(ctx.invalidLead||lead.invalidLead); const motivation=Number(lead.motivationScore??seller.motivationScore??0); const distress=Number(property.distressScore??ctx.distressScore??0); const equityPct=Number(property.equityPercent??ctx.equityPercent??0); const equityScore=Math.max(0,Math.min(100,equityPct)); const value=Number(property.arv??property.estimatedValue??ctx.arv??ctx.estimatedValue??0); const repairs=Number(property.repairs??ctx.repairs??0); const repairBurden=value>0?Math.max(0,Math.min(100,(repairs/value)*100)):0; const repairScore=100-repairBurden; const timeline=Number(lead.timelineScore??seller.timelineScore??0); const occupancy=String(property.occupancy??seller.occupancy??'unknown').toLowerCase(); const occupancyScore=occupancy==='vacant'?100:occupancy==='owner_occupied'?65:occupancy==='tenant_occupied'?55:40; const ownershipYears=Number(seller.ownershipYears??lead.ownershipYears??0); const ownershipScore=Math.max(0,Math.min(100,ownershipYears*8)); const contactability=Number(lead.contactabilityScore??ctx.contactabilityScore??0); const sourceQuality=Number(ctx.sourceQualityScore??lead.sourceQualityScore??0); const engagement=Number(lead.engagementScore??ctx.engagementScore??0); const factors={distressScore:distress,equityScore,repairScore,motivationScore:motivation,timelineScore:timeline,occupancyScore,ownershipScore,contactabilityScore:contactability,sourceQualityScore:sourceQuality,engagementScore:engagement}; const weighted=(distress*.18)+(equityScore*.14)+(repairScore*.08)+(motivation*.16)+(timeline*.12)+(occupancyScore*.06)+(ownershipScore*.05)+(contactability*.08)+(sourceQuality*.05)+(engagement*.08); const score=Math.round(Math.max(0,Math.min(100,weighted))); const status=suppressed||dnc?'blocked':invalid?'invalid':score>=75?'qualified':score>=50?'nurture':'low_priority'; const tier=status==='blocked'||status==='invalid'?'blocked':score>=80?'A':score>=60?'B':'C'; const nextAction=status==='blocked'?'do_not_contact':status==='invalid'?'manual_data_review':score>=75?'priority_seller_outreach':score>=50?'nurture_and_requalify':'low_cost_follow_up'; const evidence=[]; if(distress>=70)evidence.push('high_property_distress'); if(equityScore>=70)evidence.push('strong_equity'); if(motivation>=70)evidence.push('high_seller_motivation'); if(timeline>=70)evidence.push('near_term_timeline'); if(repairs>0&&repairBurden>=20)evidence.push('meaningful_repair_burden'); if(occupancy==='vacant')evidence.push('vacant_property'); if(contactability>=70)evidence.push('high_contactability'); if(engagement>=70)evidence.push('high_engagement'); const confidence=Math.round(Math.max(0,Math.min(100,50+(Object.values(factors).filter(v=>Number.isFinite(v)&&v>0).length*5)))); const idempotencyKey='wf405:'+input.leadId+':'+(input.source||'unknown')+':'+(input.campaignId||'none'); return [{json:{...input,context:ctx,lead,property,seller,qualification:{status,tier,priorityScore:score,confidence,recommendedNextAction:nextAction,factors,evidence,estimatedValue:value,arv:Number(property.arv??ctx.arv??0),repairs,protectedFields:{internalScoring:true}},guardrails:{suppressed,dnc,invalid},idempotencyKey}}}];

meta.notes: Priority scoring is deterministic scaffold logic pending production InsulaCRM schema, AI scoring contract, and verified lead/property field mappings.
